ball-health.name: Ball Health Providence Park
ball-health.statusNote: Ball Health is engaged: Josh chased the spare display quote and Raymond asked about above door room number signs on 22 Sep. Keys mid November, first resident within 30 to 60 days. Watch: the new server IP is five days overdue and the MatrixCare authorization form is still unsigned; both sit with Raymond. Josh is out two weeks from Fri 25 Sep.

crawford.name: Crawford County Memorial Hospital
crawford.scope: ED and Med Surg whiteboards, Wallmate door displays, 3 unit status boards
crawford.statusNote: Scope was to be final by 11 Sep. Builds and testing must be complete before the 5 Oct Oracle update; original go live target no later than 30 Sep. Li is working the Oracle integration. Rauland code blue and nurse call testing still to schedule.

dosher.name: Dosher Memorial Hospital ED
dosher.scope: 9 bed ED: whiteboards, Wallmate door displays, unit status board, virtual nursing
dosher.statusNote: John took the project over from David in September and considers it far from ready; target wrap is September. TruBridge says the ADT interface is largely working. RTLS and nurse call are nearly ready to test now that Wi Fi ADB is on; some RTLS sensors are offline and two drop boxes and one badge collector are not installed.

good-sam.meetingAttendees: Brandy Shouse, Amanda Siewers, Jennifer Weger, Deborah Snyder, Brant White · HCI: John, Greg
good-sam.name: Good Samaritan Virtual Sitter
good-sam.scope: Virtual nurse console and eSitter on whiteboard cameras; 3 nurse stations plus 1 remote station
good-sam.statusNote: End of September go live is an executive deadline Brandy's leadership is tracking. Server spec confirmed 18 Sep and Joey builds the on site video server, about two weeks. Updated software received and an installable prototype was due mid week of 21 Sep. SSL warning on the test board still open. Staff training went live 23 Sep as the Virtual Nurse Academy.

goshen-esitter.name: Goshen Health eSitter
goshen-esitter.scope: Virtual sitter platform on Genetec camera feeds with in room red lights
goshen-esitter.statusNote: After the 14 Sep visit John decided to reimagine the eSitter and unit status board view rather than patch it. The six fixes, the new view and a standalone Windows eSitter app ship as one release, about two weeks of development, at no cost to Goshen.
